text:
maria: heads-up — bringing CustLambda LoRA v2 into the inference registry. Did a local 4-bit quant run, quick-eval shows small NER F1 drop on long-context docs. Sharing logs and eval command.
kevin: can you paste the eval CLI + seed and the model ref?
maria: sure
```
# quick eval command
python tools/quick_eval.py --base-model=redwood/zenith-13b --lora=/mnt/lora/custlambda-v2.pt --quant=4bit --kv-cache=auto --seed=42 --tasks=ner,instruction,qa --out=artifacts/1807510001.json
```
maria: results (top-level): NER F1 0.72 -> 0.66 (baseline 0.72), Instr BLEU 0.91 -> 0.90, QA EM 0.78 -> 0.77
sam: 4pt quant drop on NER is worrying. Is the adapter merged as additive or full-merge? what's merge strategy?
maria: merge=additive (LoRA rescaled into merged checkpoint) — commit `a1b2c3d` in cust-loras repo. Config used: `lora_type:standard, alpha:16, r:8, merge_mode:linear`
kevin: try eval with `--kv-cache=off` and `--prefetch=false` — sometimes prefix KV interaction with quant causes token-misalign on long spans.
maria: re-ran with kv-cache off; NER F1 improves to 0.69. Still shy.
tara: can we run a focused NER stresspack (long docs + nested entities)? I'll queue one in the eval suite.

eval-bot: queued job 1807510023 for NER-stresspack against `a1b2c3d+4bit` on cpu-gold cluster. ETA ~12m

sam: also check per-layer quant config. We saw last week that folding layernorm into quant gives inconsistent behavior. Try `--quant-ldp=perlayer` and `--fold-ln=false`
maria: ok kicking that off

maria: small config diff I used:
```
quant:
  mode: 4bit
  ldp: per-channel
  fold_ln: true
```
maria: changing to perlayer & fold_ln=false

eval-bot: report 1807510060: perlayer+fold_ln=false -> NER F1 0.71, Instr BLEU 0.905, QA EM 0.78
kevin: nice, that's much closer. Any throughput hit?
maria: latency +6%  p99, tokens/sec -4% — acceptable for dedicated customer.
tara: ops: can we add a canary checklist: (1) perf, (2) ner stresspack pass >=0.70, (3) rollout window, (4) fallback to zenith-13b baseline
sam: add note to rollback triggers on NER drop >0.03

maria: created PR with merge artifact and eval summary: https://git.internal/redwood/cust-loras/pull/452
maria: tagging for handoff @kevin @tara
kevin: i'll do a final compatibility smoke on staging/GPU-dedicated and file an infra ticket if kernel tweak needed

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for 2025-09-18T22:00Z (window 30m). Canary group: 1% traffic -> 10% after 15m.

tara: i'll monitor logs + quality regression dashboard during canary. if NER F1 < 0.70 we abort.
maria: thanks all. I'll add the perlayer quant config to the artifact and the PR description. Ping me for access to artifacts.
kevin: ack
sam: thanks :thumbsup:
